text: The Integrity Commissioner has jurisdiction to conduct inquiries pursuant to the City of Toronto Act, 2006 and Chapter 3 of the Toronto Municipal Code. Under section 4.4(E)(2), the Commissioner may terminate an investigation if the Commissioner is of the opinion that the inquiry would serve no useful purpose. This Report for Action transmits to City Council the Commissioner's decision to terminate an investigation against former Councillor Justin Di Ciano. The Commissioner is filing this report with City Council for its information.
City Council on December 16, 17 and 18, 2020, adopted the following: 1. City Council receive the report (December 10, 2020) from the Integrity Commissioner for information.
